name: Hanoi to Hue
summary: The five SE trains take 12 hours 35 minutes to 14 hours 12 minutes. A flight time and a Hanoi sleeper-bus time are check on arrival.

modes.note: No block time is published. Airport rides at both ends are extra.
The five SE trains on the Vietnam Railways board. SE3 is the short end and SE9 is the long end. Book a berth, not a hard seat.
A Hanoi sleeper-bus duration was not on the railway board or the Hue station reply.

seoTitle: Hanoi to Hue travel — SE trains, flights, and buses
seoDescription: The five SE trains from Hanoi to Hue take 12 hours 35 minutes to 14 hours 12 minutes. Flight times and the sleeper bus are check on arrival.

faqs.a: Take an SE train if the overnight coast is part of the trip. A flight time is check on arrival, so compare the ticket you are offered with the train’s 12 hours 35 minutes to 14 hours 12 minutes.
